requirements_summary: Mid-market product analytics company seeking Redwood as inference platform. Primary workloads: embeddings for document search + chat assist for product support. Latency targets: p50 <= 150ms for short chat turns, p95 <= 300ms. Throughput target: sustained 250k embedding units/month initially, scale to 500k. Must support VPC/Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation. Security: SOC2 Type II, SSO/SAML, audit logging with 1y retention (configurable), customer-managed KMS, EU data residency for subset of customers.
